_about: Kitchen-sink example guide built only from the template examples. Used by scripts/test_guide.js and as a reference for what a finished guide folder looks like.
_guide_title: Artifact name and page title. 2 to 6 words. Usually '<course> <exam> Study Guide'.
_header_kicker: Small line above the title: course, exam, date and time. Under 50 characters.
_course_full: Used in the tutor prompts for Ask and Solve it for me: 'You are a tutor for <course_full>'.
subject: physics
_subject: One or two words. The tutor answers out-of-scope questions 'from standard <subject> knowledge'.
exam_format: closed book, 50 minutes, mostly multiple choice and true/false
_calculator: false: worked solutions and Solve it for me approximate by hand at the end. true: they may evaluate directly.
_exam_minutes: Length of the REAL exam in minutes. For reference and for sizing practice_minutes.
_practice_minutes: Time target for the practice exam page (the only place it is set). Equal to exam_minutes when the guide covers the whole exam; otherwise the guide's share of it, e.g. 2 of 5 lectures of a 50-minute quiz = 20.
_unit_label: What one unit page is called: Lecture, Chapter, Topic, Week, Module. Used in the contents, cards and summary.
scope_line: Two example lectures and a practice exam
_scope_line: Kicker on the start page: what the guide covers. Under 70 characters.
_student_name: Optional. If empty the tutor prompts say 'the student'.
_storage_key: Unique per guide, lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. Prefix of every browser storage key, so two guides never share progress.

style._style: Writing defaults for the guide text and the tutor prompts. Change them if the user asks. prompt_extra is appended to every tutor prompt.
